cn.t: Critics hail this RSC adaptation as a triumph, praising its anarchic energy, clever wit, and spectacular child performances. Tim Minchin and Dennis Kelly's work captures Dahl's dark mischief perfectly, with Bertie Carvel's Trunchbull a standout.
